as_told.title: Pyramids aligned with Orion's Belt as a place where souls ascend

plain: The podcast host Jesse Michels says in 2025 that the three great pyramids at Giza in Egypt line up exactly with Orion's Belt, the row of three bright stars in the constellation Orion. He says that perfect match happened around 10,600 BC, when the sky shifted into that position. Graham Hancock, an author who writes about lost ancient civilisations, also talks about the pyramids lining up with Orion's Belt, but he gives no date. He says instead that in many cultures Orion's Belt was seen as the place where souls rise to after death. If true, the alignment would point either to a much older plan for the pyramids or to a spiritual purpose.
